messages:
Ana: Quick question  default billing view: compact project cards or invoice ledger? Trying to minimize noise for PLG.
Devon: Compact cards default, ledger behind an expand/tab. Less initial API load.
Sasha: Tech note: lazy-load ledger lines on expand (GET /billing/:org/invoice/:id/lines). Also add ETag for rollup caching.
Matt: Accessibility nit: token chips fail contrast at small sizes. Propose heavier weight or outlined chips. Also aria-labels on download buttons (e.g., aria-label="Save invoice as PDF").
Jordan: Telemetry: track billing.view.default and billing.rollup.expanded. Surface scope pill (top chip) on wide screens, left-rail fallback on narrow.
Ana: I'll update Figma with compact + ledger fallback and add aria-live for export status. Will push frames by EOD. :thumbsup:
